# `<sl-divider>` — Divider

Dividers are used to visually separate or group elements.

**Status:** stable · **Since:** 2.0

**Import:** `import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/divider/divider.js';`

## Attributes

Every attribute is also a property (camelCase name in the second column when it differs). Boolean attributes are on when present: never write `="false"`, remove the attribute or bind the property instead.

| Attribute | Property | Type / allowed values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vertical` | — | `boolean` | `false` | Draws the divider in a vertical orientation. |

## CSS custom properties

| Property | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--color` | — | The color of the divider. |
| `--width` | — | The width of the divider. |
| `--spacing` | — | The spacing of the divider. |

## Documentation and examples

```html
<sl-divider></sl-divider>
```

```ts
import '@shoelace-style/shoelace/dist/components/divider/divider.js';
import { Component, CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA } from '@angular/core';

@Component({
  selector: 'app-divider-example',
  schemas: [CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA],
  template: `<sl-divider></sl-divider>`
})
export class DividerExampleComponent {}
```

## Examples

### Width

Use the `--width` custom property to change the width of the divider.

```html
<sl-divider style="--width: 4px;"></sl-divider>
```

### Color

Use the `--color` custom property to change the color of the divider.

```html
<sl-divider style="--color: tomato;"></sl-divider>
```

### Spacing

Use the `--spacing` custom property to change the amount of space between the divider and it's neighboring elements.

```html
<div style="text-align: center;">
  Above
  <sl-divider style="--spacing: 2rem;"></sl-divider>
  Below
</div>
```

### Vertical

Add the `vertical` attribute to draw the divider in a vertical orientation. The divider will span the full height of its container. Vertical dividers work especially well inside of a flex container.

```html
<div style="display: flex; align-items: center; height: 2rem;">
  First
  <sl-divider vertical></sl-divider>
  Middle
  <sl-divider vertical></sl-divider>
  Last
</div>
```

### Menu Dividers

Use dividers in [menus](menu.md) to visually group menu items.

```html
<sl-menu style="max-width: 200px;">
  <sl-menu-item value="1">Option 1</sl-menu-item>
  <sl-menu-item value="2">Option 2</sl-menu-item>
  <sl-menu-item value="3">Option 3</sl-menu-item>
  <sl-divider></sl-divider>
  <sl-menu-item value="4">Option 4</sl-menu-item>
  <sl-menu-item value="5">Option 5</sl-menu-item>
  <sl-menu-item value="6">Option 6</sl-menu-item>
</sl-menu>
```

### Tailwind users

Using TailwindCSS with Shoelace [may override divider styles](https://github.com/shoelace-style/shoelace/issues/2088), making them invisible. As a workaround, add this to your Tailwind config file.

```css
@layer base {
  sl-divider:not([vertical]) {
    border-top: solid var(--width) var(--color);
  }

  sl-divider[vertical] {
    border-left: solid var(--width) var(--color);
  }
}
```
